pass_1_mathematical_instructional.note: Spot-checked all family goals; automated scans cover every version. Individual original constructed text problems were not all independently re-solved manually.

pass_2_duplicated_variety.note: Near-duplicates are flagged for further teacher review rather than automatically deleted; some are intentional curricular spirals.

pass_3_mathjax_browser.note: Browser tested live MathJax with representative chapters and interactive controls, not screenshots of all 8,160 versions.

review_boundary: All revised questions remain teacher-review drafts. Existing review storage key remains unchanged. No automatic publishing or assembler selection map is included.
selection_boundary: Source lesson stores two spiral families and four extension choices per family. Q3/Q5 take the previous completed lesson; Q4/Q6 may take another already-completed lesson; static prebuild selection is future assembler work.
